title: Touhou Hatenkou ~ the Garden of Sinners - Tiny Birds and Thunderclaps in a Watery Sky
description:
The "Stage 1" theme from a game-without-a-game Touhou-style music album.

It's a happy song, best suited for early-to-mid game levels where you're still exploring, with not too much on the line.

[2022/10/14] Update: Now with louder percussion, a faster tempo, slightly different vibrato, a corrected inaccuracy in the trumpet, and an option to change the piano.

A define at the top of the file can be changed to use either @1 or @9 for the piano.
